characterInteraction.description: Aisha initiates the conversation by asking a question. Robin responds and explains her reasoning for coining the term "white fragility".

scenes.contextualRelevance: Insightful discussion on the social perception and challenges of discussing race among white communities.

narrativeProgression.description: Aisha asks Robin about the term "white fragility" and why it causes controversy.
Robin explains the offensiveness of the term and shares her observations from racial discussions with white audiences.
White fragility is described by Robin as reactions to challenges on racial views, emphasizing their emotional response.
Robin outlines the perceived racial equilibrium that supports white supremacy, discussing the discomfort of acknowledging racism.
The term's resonance with familiar patterns in progressive white communities is noted by Robin.
